title: How I Hacked PickMe Fare
description: I followed two ordinary route metrics through PickMe's Android app, changed a controlled fare estimate, responsibly reported the issue, and watched it get fixed.

title: What I Found Inside a Famous ePassbook App in Sri Lanka
description: I opened an archived Android APK to practise reverse engineering. One small search led me through broken TLS checks, embedded credentials, local encryption, logs, and a legacy request format.
